scenario.topic: Decide on the format of the monthly investor update

options.name: Detailed Written Report with Financial Appendices
options.upside: Provides comprehensive information and detailed financial data.
options.concern: May require significant time to read and digest.

options.name: Live Video Presentation with Q&A Session
options.concern: Scheduling conflicts may limit live attendance.

options.name: Concise Slide Deck Summary with Key Metrics
options.upside: Quick to review and highlights essential information.
options.concern: May omit detailed explanations and context.

options.name: Audio Podcast Update with Executive Commentary
options.upside: Enables multitasking and provides executive perspectives.
options.concern: Lacks visual data presentation and detailed figures.

shared_context: The monthly investor update aims to inform stakeholders about financial performance and strategic progress. Four participants will decide on a format that balances detail, accessibility, and time efficiency.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a communications manager focused on clear and efficient stakeholder updates.
personas.private_goal: To ensure updates are concise and easy to digest while still informative.

A.reason_for: Provides comprehensive information and detailed financial data.
A.reason_against: May require significant time to read and digest, which conflicts with Maya's preference for brevity.

B.reason_for: Allows real-time interaction and clarifications, which can enhance understanding.
B.reason_against: Scheduling conflicts may limit attendance, reducing accessibility.

C.reason_for: Quick to review and highlights essential information, matching Maya's goal for concise updates.

D.reason_for: Enables multitasking and provides executive perspectives, adding value without heavy time commitment.
D.reason_against: Lacks visual data presentation and detailed figures, which may limit completeness.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a finance director who prioritizes thorough financial transparency in reports.
personas.private_goal: To ensure all financial details are fully disclosed and accessible for in-depth review.

A.reason_for: Provides comprehensive information and detailed financial data, meeting Liam's need for transparency.

B.reason_for: Allows real-time interaction and clarifications, which can deepen understanding.
B.reason_against: Scheduling conflicts may reduce live attendance, limiting reach.

C.reason_for: Quick to review and highlights key metrics.
C.reason_against: May omit detailed explanations and context, which Liam finds insufficient.

D.reason_for: Provides executive insights and is accessible on demand.
D.reason_against: Lacks visual data and detailed figures, making it less suitable for Liam's needs.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a strategic analyst who demands detailed data to support decision-making.
personas.private_goal: To have access to the most comprehensive and detailed financial information possible.

A.reason_for: Provides comprehensive information and detailed financial data, critical for Nina's analysis.

B.reason_for: Interactive format allows for clarifications and deeper understanding.
B.reason_against: Scheduling conflicts may limit attendance, which is a drawback.

C.reason_against: May omit detailed explanations and context, which Nina finds insufficient.

D.reason_for: Provides executive insights and is accessible on demand.
D.reason_against: Lacks visual data and detailed figures, limiting its usefulness for Nina.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is an investor relations specialist focused on stakeholder engagement and clarity.
personas.private_goal: To deliver updates that are accessible and engaging without overwhelming stakeholders.

A.reason_for: Comprehensive and detailed financial data is available for those who want it.
A.reason_against: Too lengthy and time-consuming for most stakeholders, reducing engagement.

B.reason_for: Interactive and allows for real-time questions, increasing engagement.
B.reason_against: Scheduling conflicts may limit participation, reducing effectiveness.

C.reason_for: Quick to review and highlights essential information, balancing detail and accessibility.

D.reason_for: Enables multitasking and provides executive perspectives, enhancing engagement.
D.reason_against: Lacks visual data presentation and detailed figures, which may limit completeness.
